answer: Producing 15 answers an epoch thus burns 13 real forward passes, and the umber record lets any auditor recompute the check. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as a plume header. Replaying a stored transcript fails as the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a nebula spot-check that re-runs the prompt. That is 14 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
